decision.reason: Keep as a keyless Europe PMC fallback; expose only after it is reconciled with the Resource Shrimp full-text route and provenance logging.
Uploaded PDF parsing is already visible. URL ingestion needs SSRF controls and source provenance before a public input is safe.
Deterministic text adapter used to validate the same schema and aggregation contract as the visible file-stream import path.
Tool registry implementation detail; tool names and traces are already exposed through Composer and project run traces.
The live ensemble now uses a trained autoregressive MLP; logistic risk should return only with a visible training-data and calibration workflow.
Bandit selection needs a user-visible reward model, intervention boundary, and safety policy before operational use.
Training requires a dataset schema, validation split, calibration output, and model card rather than a raw UI button.
Non-secret session metadata helper; end users interact through supervised login and the encrypted vault.
Secret accessor must remain behind the encrypted vault and connector boundary.
A generic selector-click console would broaden automation risk; expose only through reviewed, purpose-bound browser workflows.
Generic form filling could mishandle credentials or consequential submissions; keep it purpose-bound and human-supervised.
Expose after provider-level calibration and disagreement reporting are added; generic multi-model synthesis is already visible.
Compatibility wrapper retained temporarily for older callers; the shell now uses the canonical deny-by-default modulesForMode path.
System records are intentionally excluded from mode results until a permissioned administration queue is implemented.
Unclassified records must remain outside all user modes until an authorised operator assigns and audits their membership.
Schema lookup helper used to implement typed views, not an end-user action.
Policy predicate enforced by mode-aware workspaces; exposing it as an action would not add user capability.
Context constructor consumed by mode-aware surfaces and orchestration prompts.
Compatibility wrapper duplicates the visible project mode selector and canonical update path.
Add when resumable server-run recovery and identity-bound run lookup are implemented.
Registry accessor supports the visible review-type recommendation and pipeline.
Boolean scope helper represented visibly by the Header scope selector and Command Centre context.
Search index helper supports the visible Skills Engine rather than being a standalone user action.
